title: Sovereign Lowering Envelope
description: M5 import contract (): the minimum reviewable, versioned manifest that wraps EXTERNALLY lowered artifacts so a console / network / agents consumer can safely accept them WITHOUT trusting the producing compiler. Carries source hash, language/artifact versions, producer identity, target/backend, capability id, per-artifact hashes, diagnostics, and a self-describing compatibility surface (`translatorVersion`, kind neutrino.translator-version) that the consumer fails closed against via scripts/gates/check_compatibility.py — the same surface official `--version-json` / manifest.json emit, so a console needs no parallel manifest. Compatible with both the official translator and future participant-owned compilers (sovereignty: the envelope is self-describing; the CONSUMER decides acceptability against its own requirements).

sourceHash.description: hash of the source the artifacts were lowered from.

languageVersion.description: the source-language level version the producer targeted (required so a missing language version fails closed).

official.description: true iff produced by the official translator; a consumer MAY require official, but the envelope also supports sovereign participant compilers.

backend.description: generator target, e.g. solidity | postgres | slot.

runtimeProfile.description: backend profile id, e.g. evm.v1 (see the backend-profile catalog).

artifacts.description: every emitted artifact, each with a content hash so the consumer can verify integrity without re-running the compiler.

path.description: path to the artifact, RELATIVE to the import/artifact root — POSIX ('/...') and Windows ('C:\\...') absolute paths and '..' traversal (with '/' or '\\' separators) are rejected so the bundle boundary holds.

role.description: e.g. capability-identity | backend-model | binding-topology | operations | compensation | transcript.

ref.description: path to a diagnostics.json, RELATIVE to the import root (POSIX + Windows absolute and '/' or '\\' traversal rejected).

translatorVersion.description: the producer's self-declared compatibility surface — a neutrino.translator-version envelope (the same shape --version-json / manifest.json carry), so a consumer fails closed against it with the EXISTING scripts/gates/check_compatibility.py (no parallel manifest). For the official translator this equals VersionInfo.h; a sovereign producer declares its own, and the consumer accepts or refuses against its requirements.
